cards.complexityReason: Creates multiple aggregates (Ask, AskVersion, AskResource, WorkflowTask, AskComment, AskAttachmentLink) atomically, changes workflow state conditionally based on submitter role and buttonValue, and writes an outbox event on SUBMIT.

differences.masterLldValue: POST /api/v1/asks (with type discriminator for Core vs Rotational)

differences.item: HTTP status code for business validation failures (endDate before today, endDate not after projectedStartDate, fteAmount exceeds headCountAmount)
differences.masterLldValue: 400 validation_failed (MLLD 12.2 defines 400 for invalid request; 422 is not in the approved error catalogue)

differences.item: Workflow routing on SUBMIT: leadership-group submitters route to status 145 DPP Ops Review, bypassing PPL Review
differences.specValue: Leadership submitters → status 145 DPP Ops Review; non-leadership → status 127 PPL Review
differences.masterLldValue: Core ASK baseline routing: Draft → PPL Review → DPP Ops Review. Leadership submitter shortcut noted but exact bypass path not fully specified in MLLD 7.4.

differences.item: buttonValue=Exit as a no-op API call
differences.specValue: Exit button sends POST /core-asks with buttonValue=Exit and expects no persistence
differences.masterLldValue: No equivalent no-op POST pattern in the Master LLD API catalogue; Exit is typically a client-side navigation concern

differences.item: Duplicate field numberofresources appears twice in both request and response schemas
differences.specValue: numberofresources: 1 and numberofresources: 2 both present in the same schema object
differences.masterLldValue: No duplicate field pattern in approved OpenAPI or entity definitions

missingFacts.item: Exact permission code required to call POST /core-asks
Definition of leadership group membership rule for routing to status 145 vs 127
Status ID to name mapping: 123 = In Progress, 127 = PPL Review, 145 = DPP Ops Review — confirmation required
Exact reference IDs for the top-3 set of levelNeedId that triggers mandatory rolePostingId
Exact reference IDs for first option of needReasonId and generalSpecialityNeedId used in clearing rules
File-upload contract for documents field (MIME types, size limits, number of files, multipart vs base64)
Idempotency key requirement and scope for this POST operation
Transaction scope confirmation for all aggregates and OutboxMessage in single SaveChangesAsync
Outbox event type, version, minimal payload, recipient rule and template key for SUBMIT event
BU scope rule for Core ASK creation
Whether needReasonId = retirement exempts endDate entirely or only from the after-projectedStartDate rule
Approved OpenAPI operation ID and schema component names

blockers: Specification uses HTTP 422 for business validation failures but MLLD 12.2 defines only 400 validation_failed. Conflict must be resolved before error contract can be finalised.
Specification defines POST /core-asks but MLLD 15 proposed catalogue defines POST /api/v1/asks. Path and type-discriminator approach must be confirmed by Solution Architecture.
Request and response schemas contain a duplicate field numberofresources. This specification defect must be resolved by the API Contract owner before the schema can be used.

assumptions: ADO work item number 1857 is inferred from the example pairing in the DC Planner prompt instructions (US-ASK-001 ↔ ADO 1857); the specification file itself contains no explicit ADO number.
buttonValue=Exit is treated as a client-side no-op per the specification assumption; the API card notes this pattern has no precedent in the Master LLD.
The duplicate numberofresources field in the specification schema is treated as a specification defect and not modelled as two separate fields.
Status numeric IDs 123, 127, and 145 are taken directly from the specification acceptance criteria; their mapping to state names is assumed correct pending Business Analysis confirmation.
The first option clearing rules for needReasonId and generalSpecialityNeedId refer to the lowest-ID or default reference data entry; exact IDs are a missing fact for Business Analysis.
